image_description: A large, complex agricultural implement (likely a combination plow/cultivator) attached to the rear of an orange tractor. The machine features multiple large rubber tires, a heavy metal frame painted red/orange, and various hydraulic arms and linkages. It is situated in a harvested field with dry stubble. In the background, other tractors and flags are visible under a cloudy sky.
